old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a large industrial machine, specifically a shredder with rotating, toothed metal components, in operation. A cylindrical object, appearing to be a light green metal barrel with visible wear and dirt, is being processed. The barrel is progressively crushed and deformed as it is pulled into the machine, its shape collapsing and flattening against the rotating teeth. The camera angle remains fixed, focusing on the interaction between the shredder and the barrel. A person wearing a light-colored shirt and dark shorts is partially visible at the bottom right of the frame, standing near the machine. The background shows a concrete floor and some greenery in the distance, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor industrial setting. There are no animals or human characters actively interacting with the machinery beyond the person standing nearby. The focus remains solely on the mechanical process of shredding the barrel.

caption:
The video captures a rotated shredder scene, with two interlocking toothed metal rotors beside a concrete floor, a red plate, and the corner logo. A light green and white drum, already rust smudged and dented, rests diagonally across the rotor gap. The rotors turn continuously, and the drum's left edge is pressed into the teeth, while a person in a light shirt and dark shorts stands partly visible at the lower edge, wearing a white glove and watching the machine from the right side.

The left side of the drum folds inward into a deep crease as the metal yields to the rotating teeth. The upper teeth grip the rim and draw the body upward into the shredder gap. The open top bends over, and the cylinder collapses into a curved, flattened shell. The person remains beside the machine, hand near the edge, while the drum continues to turn steadily inside the rotors.

The visible portion shows the drum still gripped, partly flattened, and held in the shredder's teeth during the ongoing shredding process.
